pages.title: A Quilted Ride
pages.text: Tame a Clydesdale, equip a supported quilted blanket and gallop on it.

pages.title: A Quilted Ride
pages.text: Horseshoes and fodder support continued use of the heavy horse already tamed and equipped.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A compatible spotted or quilted rug doubles as a heavy horse blanket. Home textiles and mount equipment share a material route; use the native blanket slot.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply a supported quilt or quilt carpet as a Clydesdale blanket. Farm decoration items also serve as horse blankets.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Tame a Clydesdale, gallop and equip Quilted Rug or Spotted Carpet. The native advancements describe both riding and blanket customization.
